task: Ground factual claims for open Impress template collection.
output_summary: Collected license-cleared public LibreOffice Impress templates into presentation-agent, packaged them as .otp files, rendered thumbnail/provenance/text HTML reference pages, generated a gallery and registry, and validated the collector and gallery.

evidence.reliability: Generated registry records 7 collections and 119 template records with provenance, license, local file, thumbnail, and HTML paths.

evidence.source: find presentation-agent/data/assets/raw/open-impress-templates/files -name '*.otp' | wc -l; find presentation-agent/data/assets/thumbnails/open-impress-templates -type f | wc -l; find presentation-agent/data/conversions/html/open-impress-templates -name '*.html' | wc -l

evidence.reliability: Tracked deterministic collector for packaging ODF templates and rendering registry/gallery outputs.
Command output showed 22 Playwright tests passed, including the open Impress gallery smoke test on desktop and mobile.
Search record lists queries, checked sources, excluded weak/restricted sources, plan impact, and uncertainty.
Docs explicitly state the HTML output is reference-only, not high-fidelity PPT rendering.

claims.statement: The task generated 119 .otp files, 119 thumbnails, and 119 HTML reference pages.
verification_steps: Checked generated registry summary and file counts.

claims.statement: The collected templates came from seven license-reviewed collections in the dohliam/libreoffice-impress-templates GitHub archive.
verification_steps: Read registry records and web search record.

claims.statement: LibreTemplates raw files were not stored because the license page restricts redistribution.
verification_steps: Recorded the license-page exclusion in web search and research notes.

claims.statement: The generated HTML is reference-only and not high-fidelity PPT rendering.
verification_steps: Read conversion docs and registry conversion notes.

claims.statement: The collector and generated gallery passed Python unit tests, browser tests, and config self-documenting validation.
verification_steps: Ran Python tests, Playwright tests, and config contract check.

uncertainty_notes: The lo35 collection README says the templates appear to be LGPLv3, so future public/commercial redistribution should still perform item-level review.
High-fidelity .otp/.pptx conversion remains unverified because LibreOffice/soffice is not installed in the current environment.
limitation_notes: This task collected LibreOffice Impress .otp files rather than PPTX files.
Free template galleries with restrictive redistribution terms remain metadata/link references, not stored raw files.
